name: RfcArchiveOperation
preview: resolve exact requested RFC and proposed exact_rfc or reviewed_branch scope
for branch scope enumerate only the root and current direct subordinates with revisions/current archive states
show members that would transition active->archived separately from already archived members that will remain untouched
compute a canonical SHA-256 scope_fingerprint over exact reviewed membership/revisions/current archive states
archive: inside one UnitOfWork re-resolve exact scope and require the reviewed fingerprint/revisions still match
allocate rfc_archive_operation_id and insert command receipt/operation row
for each currently active reviewed member set only local_archive_state=archived and increment RFC revision
insert operation membership and one archived event only for RFCs actually transitioned by this operation
already archived members receive no membership/event and are not claimed by this operation
audit exact changed members and commit
restore_operation: load exact committed archive operation and its immutable changed-member set
for each member inspect its latest archive event and current RFC archive state
eligible restore member must still be archived and its latest archive event must be archived from this same origin operation
members independently restored/rearchived later are skipped as no-longer-owned-by-operation, never overwritten
inside one UnitOfWork transition only eligible members to active, increment revisions, append restored events referencing the origin operation, audit exact results and commit
rules: archive/restore changes only SOMA-local RFC presentation state
archive never changes RFC source lifecycle/status, hierarchy, SR links, WFM/Task/Objective state or Communications
master/root archive is never an implicit recursive side effect; branch membership must be explicitly previewed and revalidated
operation-scoped restore prevents a later restore from activating an RFC that this operation did not archive
